label: Employee and action API views
instruction: Generate one concise DRF APIView file at modules/complaint_cms/api/views.py, maximum 95 lines. ComplaintListView GET calls list_complaints(request.principal) serialized with ComplaintSerializer(many=True), POST validates ComplaintSerializer and calls submit_complaint(request.principal, serializer.validated_data). TaskListView GET calls assigned_tasks(request.principal) serialized with ComplaintTaskSerializer(many=True). NotificationListView GET calls list_notifications(request.principal) serialized with ComplaintNotificationSerializer(many=True). ComplaintActionView POST calls act_on_complaint(request.principal, pk, str(request.data.get("action", "")), request.data) and returns ComplaintSerializer(complaint).data. Use IsAuthenticated, HasModuleGrant("complaint_cms"), and HasPermission class factories in permission_classes, and annotate methods with @extend_schema from drf_spectacular.utils. Return raw Python source only without code fences.
